messages.text:
No. Refunds cannot be redirected to another account or IBAN, and a staff member cannot approve an exception. The seller note does not change this rule. A refund can go only to the order’s original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment instead?
